title: Drifter Bar Salts Strawberry Kiwi 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Kiwi by Drifter Bar Salts blends two timeless fruits into a bright and uplifting vape. The sweet, sun-ripened taste of Strawberry pairs perfectly with the tangy, tropical bite of Kiwi, creating a vibrant fruit fusion that’s juicy, punchy, and full of character. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Blackcurrant Ice to Lime Raspberry Cherry, to Blueberry and Cherry and Watermelon Strawberry Bubblegum, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
